title: cephalaria squamiflora subsp. mediterranea
intro: Cephalaria squamiflora subsp. mediterranea, commonly known as the Mediterranean Cephalaria or Ironwort, is a plant species in the honeysuckle family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. It is known to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Cephalaria squamiflora subsp. mediterranea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antiproliferative activities.
